title: Database Provisioning Spec Compiler
description: Compiles the database instance provisioning specification. Enforces: non-EOL engine version, encryption-at-rest for PII tiers, deletion protection and multi-AZ for production, backup retention compliance, and appropriate storage type for declared IOPS.

error_codes.DPS001: db-provisioning-spec.json missing or invalid — required fields: platform, engine, engine_version, instance_class, storage_type, multi_az, deletion_protection, encryption_at_rest, backup_retention_days
error_codes.DPS002: Engine version is EOL or unrecognised — declare a supported, non-EOL PostgreSQL version
error_codes.DPS003: PII-tier or production instance missing encryption_at_rest: true
error_codes.DPS004: Production instance missing deletion_protection: true — prevents accidental database deletion
error_codes.DPS005: Production HA instance has multi_az: false — production databases must run multi-AZ
error_codes.DPS006: Backup retention below compliance minimum — production requires ≥ 7 days
error_codes.DPS007: Storage type is gp2 but provisioned IOPS declared — use gp3 or io1/io2 for explicit IOPS reservation
